import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();plan={'queries':['"Feng" "Sun" "Xiang" "character" "conjecture" "matroid"','"Geometry of antimatroidal point sets" conjecture staircase','"poset poly-antimatroid" staircase counterexample']}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search2-plan.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),str(p/'search2-plan.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
print('STAIR END',(p/'sources/staircase.txt').read_text()[27000:29200])
